notes.title: Creative Demo is OUT !!!
notes.content:
The Creative Demo of MindVenture is now fully available !!!

You can start playing it and make your first creations giving you a glimpse of what the full game creator mode will be!
You can also publish your creations online and explore blueprints made by other players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710307/706cfd523224877dfc60276ad72f305ac996d645.png[/img]

notes.title: Creative Demo available this month !
notes.content:
Times has come, it will finally be possible to try out MindVenture creative mode this month! In this demo you will be able to edit tiny chunks of the world and to share your creations with other players!

I can't wait to see what you will create!
Here is a short gameplay preview showcasing Story and Creative mode. (Only creative mode in this demo)

[previewyoutube=jTuAr3YFlQw;full][/previewyoutube]

It will be possible to play the Creative Mode Mid-March! Don't forget to Wishlist the game!
Thank you a lot for your support


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42710307/706cfd523224877dfc60276ad72f305ac996d645.png[/img]

notes.title: 25th January, demo will be available
notes.content:
Hi,
The 25th January will be the first day to try the early demo of Mindventure !
This demo will leave you full control of it's Adventure Maker, all mighty level editor that allows you to create rich stories !

The game is still in an alpha state, way more content will be added, a lot more polish will also be done.
As a solo-dev working in the game I will carefully listen your returns so don't hesitate to leave me feedbacks.

Thank you a lot,

-Vhalenn
